# Kiro CLI Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Kiro CLI configuration. The main output is `.kiro/steering/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - kiro
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - kiro:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                                |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| **Tier**          | Tier 2                               |
| **Main output**   | `.kiro/steering/project.md`          |
| **Dot directory** | `.kiro/`                             |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.kiro/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | No                                   |
| **Commands**      | No                                   |
| **Local files**   | No                                   |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                           | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.kiro/steering/project.md`    | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.kiro/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                       |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `simple`         | Single .kiro/steering/project.md file                        |
| `multifile`      | Single .kiro/steering/project.md file (skills via full mode) |
| `full` (default) | .kiro/steering/project.md + .kiro/skills/<name>/SKILL.md     |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/hooks/>
